$comment: Curated integrations registry (architecture.md § Integrations; auth model per docs/reference-mcp-oauth.md). Every entry offers a static-key header mode (the v1 floor) and/or MCP-spec OAuth 2.1 where the vendor's Dynamic Client Registration is verified open. userUrl entries (Supabase, Augment) have per-account endpoints the user pastes at connect. Figma remote is deliberately not connectable: no key mode, and its DCR allowlists client_name — the note says so; Figma Desktop's local MCP fits the custom-stdio escape hatch instead. Endpoints/auth facts re-verified against each vendor's docs at ship time — nothing here is guessed.

integrations.name: GitHub
integrations.note: GitHub's official remote MCP server. Uses a Personal Access Token — its OAuth is not open to third-party clients (no dynamic client registration).

header.hint: Personal Access Token from github.com/settings/tokens (repo + read:org for full tool coverage)

local.note: official github-mcp-server via Docker; a native binary also exists — see Docs

integrations.name: Figma
integrations.note: Remote is gated on Figma's MCP client catalog (VS Code, Cursor, Claude Code are listed; new clients join a waitlist — patchbay's own OAuth client isn't listed yet, and running inside VS Code doesn't inherit VS Code's listing). The desktop app's local Dev Mode server is connectable today — see the local option.

local.note: Figma desktop app must be running with the local MCP server enabled (Preferences → Enable local MCP Server, or Dev Mode's inspect panel)

integrations.name: Stitch
integrations.note: Google Labs' Stitch UI-design server. Key-only, sent as a Google API header.

integrations.name: Stripe
integrations.note: Connect with OAuth (recommended) or paste a restricted API key.

local.note: official @stripe/mcp; restrict tools and use a Restricted API Key

integrations.name: Sentry
integrations.note: Connect with OAuth, or paste a personal token — Sentry's own recommended fallback for remote-IDE setups.

header.hint: User Auth Token from sentry.io settings (org:read, project:read)

local.note: official @sentry/mcp-server; auth token from your Sentry settings

integrations.name: Postman
integrations.note: US endpoint. EU accounts: use https://mcp.eu.postman.com as a custom integration (key-only there).

header.hint: API key from postman.com account settings

integrations.name: Supabase
integrations.note: Endpoint is per-project — paste your project's MCP URL. OAuth works when the project's OAuth server has dynamic client registration enabled.

header.hint: Project API key from your Supabase dashboard

integrations.name: Augment Context Engine
integrations.note: Semantic codebase retrieval. Endpoint and credentials come from app.augmentcode.com/mcp/configuration; remote indexing additionally needs Augment's GitHub App on the repo.

local.note: Auggie CLI (npm i -g @augmentcode/auggie), authenticated via `auggie login` first
